item.title: An instrument to help you prioritize the backlog
item.description: The EOC instrument — Strategy, Objectives and Customers. A weighted questionnaire that makes the reasoning behind every prioritization decision explicit.

item.title: Lessons for anyone using — or about to use — Scrum
item.description: Fifteen practical lessons about Sprints, prioritization, ceremonies and scope — things I wish I had known before getting them wrong.

item.title: There is not just one right path!
item.description: Be wary when someone tries to sell you an absolute truth about how to build product. There is no silver bullet.

item.title: Delete every card older than 6 months
item.description: If a card has been sitting in your backlog for more than six months, it does not hurt enough. Delete it — you will feel free afterwards.

item.title: The backlog prioritization routine
item.description: Backlog prioritization is a routine and it never ends — it is like doing the dishes. Here is the cycle I use, step by step, with the tools for each stage.
